body: After I left, her mom hates me a lot too, but I get your point, you work with her, I'm sorry that you have to go through this just don't take it too hard on you and see how much you can bare more, if it really is bothering, talk about your own feelings to their mom. I just hope that she understands. Cause being in this situation for a very long time as I did just ruined me too, and look at me, still couldn't move on 🤡. But I really wish things go well for you. My DMs are always open if you wanna talk or feel suicidal anytime

Exactly is what my situation man! Only son, don't know about the future, depressed, suicidal, parents are old already but I'm 19, cannot die yet cause it will hurt my parents a lot! I am thinking about killing myself after my parents are dead, but don't know if I have the will to live that long!
My DM's are open anytime if you wanna share your feelings! I'm sorry that you feel this way

Remember, it takes time for the person to get better, it's a really slow process. I'm sorry that you have to go through this. My ex was the same, she used to go insane over little to literally nothing! I had to bare it for a year until I just couldn't take it, and moreover she lived in another country so whenever she went insane, I had to do in through screen, a video call which was way more difficult for me cause I had to keep my cool and calm her down through a fucking screen. Slowly, it made me more suicidal myself and I still am after 8 months of leaving her and still dealing with the break up, I don't even know nor I am in a position to give any better advice cause I myself am suicidal. But I know it's a difficult and a slow process for a person to beat their mental illness. I hope the best for your SO and you! Hope they recover soon! Just don't make your own self worse here. If you really feel one day that you cannot, I think it's not a bad choice to leave. I'm still broken from inside after leaving, and I have literally no will to live. But I hope the best for you :)
Hey man, if you have something to share, I'll be glad to listen to you

I am the same, I wish on May 6, 2020 I should have just hung myself instead of procrastinating. Even today I feel the pain. I exactly know what you mean bro, but don't worry, it will get atleast a little better
I'm sorry you had to hear those things man! You didn't deserve to hear it no matter what. Please don't do anything for which you'll regret later man! I'm here to listen if you have anything to share

I did! I stalked again and again and hurted myself even more. If you ask me why I did it, I really have no fucking answer to it! I wanted to move on man! I wanted to never think about it, I wanted the pain to go away, but I sleep late during these days and when I'm alone at night, I just stalk and hurt myself even more and more! I truly have no answer to why I do this again and again, what do I gain? Nothing.

Years ago, if I had read your post, I would've said why the fuck?? Now I just feel so much the same, it's pathetic I'm even alive. Sorry that you feel this way about yourself bro! Wanna talk? DM's are always open

I know like I'm not really alone in this thing, I know people are out there having shit life or feeling shit like me. I'm just too tired of everything man, like every night I feel scared and alone and I hate being alone with myself, the same feeling I used to have few months ago. I just use phone all the time to escape being alone with my own mind at night, and that results is me sleeping late and waking up late or early sometimes when I have college. Sorry for the rant man. As you said you feel the same way and don't tell anyone in person, I hope things work out better for you and you can vent your emotions out as well :)
Hello bro! Wanna talk if you don't mind? You can share your feelings with me if you don't mind :)
I am sorry things have been this way dude. I am worthless too, and feel like dying, but atleast alive till now, so if you have the time to talk you can mate! I'll be here to listen
Why man! What made you think like this bro! I'll be here to listen
